item.title: Dead by Daylight's latest Chapter finally adds the Korea map we've waited five years for, and my inner K-pop demon is obsessed
item.description: Forget Blackpink, neon lights and frights are in the area, as Dead by Daylight’s new chapter finally adds the Trickster's Delusion map.

item.title: "I don't want to play them:" 10% of the top Steam Next Fest demos admit to using generative AI
item.description: Steam Next Fest has been branded a slopfest by players trying to find games that don’t involve the use of generative AI during development.

item.title: So concrete gaming keyboards are now a thing, and I think I need one in my life
item.description: With the K2 HE Concrete Edition, Keychron is literally building a wireless keyboard out of reinforced concrete, in all its gray glory.

item.title: Death Stranding 2 system requirements are here, and you'll need an RTX 4080 to play at 4K
item.description: Minimum and recommended specs for Hideo Kojima's latest are reasonably modest, but download size is big and 4K will require a strong GPU.

item.title: New retro-styled MMO hits a new Steam high because players are… attending a poetry event?
item.description: Why risk your head out in the wilds of indie MMO Project Gorgon when you can hang back and soak in the lyrical tones of fantasy poets?

item.title: Apex Legends finally nerfs it's most overpowered character, but my guy Fuse is still completely useless
item.description: Apex Legends developer Respawn has made some balance tweaks to Octane after his recent rework, but isn’t showing any love to Fuse.

item.title: The latest entry in Ubisoft's Anno series is free to play this weekend, but there's a huge catch
item.description: When it comes with yet another login to juggle, a free weekend for city builder Anno 117 Pax Romana somehow becomes a difficult sell.

item.title: The original Simpsons Hit and Run studio is back, but here's why you should keep your remaster or sequel hopes in check
item.description: We’ve been in a long drought of The Simpsons games, but I doubt the return of original Hit and Run developer Radical will change that.

item.title: This long-awaited sequel to a classic split screen survival RPG will be DRM-free on GOG when it launches later this year
item.description: Set to launch years after its reveal, Outward 2, a rare split screen RPG, will land without DRM on everyone's favorite Steam alternative.

item.title: Discord delays its age verification, admits it knew the rollout was "going to be controversial" and that it "failed at its most basic job"
item.description: After mounting pressure and a potential user exodus, Discord's CTO has delayed the chat app's age verification plans to later in the year.
